title: UAP activity at nuclear sites
place_text: Pantex, Texas; Hanford, Washington, USA; Fukushima, Japan

tellings.quote: concerted correlation between um UFO or UAP activity and nuclear sites the pantac site in uh Texas and the Hanford plutonium production Facility have numerous UFO um sightings and correlations and in fact there this extends to overseas sites even the Fukushima incident had um had correlations

plain: UFOs, which officials now call UAP, short for unidentified anomalous phenomena, keep showing up at nuclear sites: the Pantex nuclear weapons plant in Texas, the Hanford plutonium production facility in Washington state, and even Japan's Fukushima disaster. A former Army officer named Karl Nell tells Michels there is a "concerted correlation" between such sightings and nuclear places. If true, whatever is behind them would have a special interest in nuclear power and weapons.
